purpose: Prospective paper-forward evaluation only; not a live or trading approval.

signal_entities.MODEL_CANDIDATE: Checkpoint-level model ranking over all 11 buckets. May exist without sufficient 5-share depth. It is diagnostic only and is not a PF1 signal.
signal_entities.PF1_SIGNAL: A selected bucket for which a valid synchronized snapshot exists, actual 5-share VWAP is computable, model_p - VWAP5 >= 0.02, VWAP5 <= 0.95, and all frozen data gates pass.
signal_entities.EXECUTABLE_PAPER_TRADE: A PF1_SIGNAL recorded at exactly 5 shares under the frozen one-position/fallback rules.

primary_metric.name: actual_vwap5_net_pnl
primary_metric.notes: No fixed historical stress is substituted for actual VWAP5.

allowed_actions: publish descriptive interim metrics without promotion
prohibited_actions: add probability clipping selected from outcomes

checkpoint_100.block_definition: Five consecutive non-overlapping blocks of 20 settled executable paper trades, ordered by decision timestamp.

status_mapping_at_100.FORWARD_PAPER_SUPPORTED: All core, robustness and operational gates pass. This remains paper evidence only and is not a live verdict.
status_mapping_at_100.FORWARD_PAPER_WEAK: All core gates pass, but at least one robustness or operational gate fails.
status_mapping_at_100.FORWARD_PAPER_FAILED: Aggregate actual-VWAP5 net PnL <= 0 or T60 component PnL <= 0.
status_mapping_at_100.FORWARD_CONTRACT_INVALIDATED: Config/hash drift, lookahead, journal corruption, missing immutable provenance, trading write path, or other material implementation/safety breach.
